headings.impactOnDataAnalysis: Status Mapping's Impact on ScrumUpdate's Data Analysis

content.globalFilterMappingImpact:
The mapping of Issue Status Category affects the global filter, appearing in Reports and Analysis of 
Team board, Worklog, and Release. The status filter shows ScrumUpdate's categories which once mapped, 
contains the value of the source system's categories. The filter is set to "All" by default and the 
analysis performed on Team boards, worklogs, releases, and reports is based on this filter. The 
information is fetched from the source system against these status categories. If a status category 
field is left unmapped or a duplicate value is selected for that field, the filter dropdown is 
affected which results in inaccurate data throughout the page. Even if the filter is set to "All", the 
data for an unmapped field does not show any results for that particular status.
content.dataTableInformationMappingImpact:
The graph generated in Team boards, Worklogs, Releases, and Reports are based on the ScrumUpdate's Status 
Category filters which are mapped against the source system's Status Categories. The filter is set to 
"All" by default and the graphs are populated according to the selection of the filter. If the Global 
Filter is set to "In Progress" the graphs will be populated based only on in progressed data. The 
graphs that are impacted because of this Global filter are, Burn Up Analysis, Story Analysis, Epic 
Analysis, Throughput/Velocity Analysis, Variance Indicator, and Story Defect Analysis.
content.pieChartMappingImpact:
The Pie Charts generated in Team boards, Worklogs, Releases, and Reports are based on the ScrumUpdate's 
Status Category filters which are mapped against the source system's Status Categories. The filter is 
set to "All" by default and the Pie Charts are populated according to the selection of the filter. If 
the Global Filter is set to "In Progress" the charts will be populated based only on progressed data. 
The Charts that are impacted because of this Global filter are Bug Analysis, Indicators Summary, 
Indicator's summary by team, and Alerts Analysis
content.chartsInformation:
The Data Tables generated in Team boards, Worklogs, and Releases are based on the ScrumUpdate's Status 
Category filters which are mapped against the source system's Status Categories. These Data Tables 
contain the details of the Graphs and Charts generated. The filter is set to "All" by default and the 
Data Tables are populated according to the selection of the filter.
content.sprintStatusMappingImpact:
The mapping of Sprint Statuses affects the Sprint filter, appearing in Reports and Analysis of Team 
 board. The sprint filter shows ScrumUpdate's sprint statuses which once mapped, contains the value of the 
source system's sprints. The filter appears when scrum boards are selected from the team board's 
dropdown. The information is fetched from the source system against these sprint statuses. If a sprint 
status field is left unmapped or a duplicate value is selected for that field, the filter dropdown is 
affected which results in inaccurate/missing dropdown values.
content.releaseStatusMappingImpact:
The mapping of Release Statuses affects the Release dropdown, appearing in Reports and Analysis of 
Release. The filter shows ScrumUpdate's "active" and "closed" release statuses, which once mapped, contains 
the data of the source system's releases. The filter appears when a user goes to the Analysis by 
Release page and if they try to generate a report of releases. The information is fetched from the 
source system against these release statuses. If a release status field is left unmapped or a 
duplicate value is selected for that field, the release dropdown is affected which results in 
inaccurate/missing dropdown values.
